responsibility: Implements the legacy built-in `llvm_asm!` macro by parsing the old LLVM-style inline assembly syntax with its colon-separated sections for the assembly template, outputs, inputs, clobbers, and options; validating legacy constraint and option forms; applying legacy defaults such as implicit volatility for side-effect-only asm; and producing the corresponding `LlvmInlineAsm` AST expression for later compilation stages.
